name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Mandate that the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) auto-generates the top 3 contradictions *immediately* after every creative brief. This forces real-time clarity before work starts, cutting rework and aligning teams faster. The trade-off is upfront effort for the eA9Zf, but it saves downstream chaos—no one argues later about unstated assumptions.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t just upfront effort—it’s that auto-generating contradictions *before* creative work starts embeds bias into the brief itself, locking teams into flawed assumptions before they even question them. A better alternative: require the eA9Zf to surface *only* the top 3 *gaps* in the brief’s logic, not contradictions, and let human teams debate them—this keeps the mandate actionable without preempting judgment. Settle it by running a pilot where the eA9Zf logs gaps for one cycle, then measure if teams actually resolve them faster than with contradictions.
